n1.speaker: weda
n1.text: Poor lamb's a bit under the weather. Can you feel his forehead — does he feel hot?

translations.fa: طفلکی یه کم ناخوشه. می‌تونی پیشونیش را لمس کنی — داغه؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, he feels quite hot. Shall we take his temperature?
branches.suggestionFa: آره، نسبتاً داغه. دماش را بگیریم؟

branches.suggestion: Not really — he feels normal to me.

n2.speaker: weda
n2.text: Let's check. The thermometer's in the drawer — pop it under his arm.

translations.fa: بیا چک کنیم. دماسنج تو کشوئه — بذارش زیر بغلش.

branches.suggestion: Got it. How long do I leave it?

n3.speaker: weda
n3.text: Until it beeps. There — 38.2. Not too bad. Has he been eating?

translations.fa: تا بوق بزنه. ایناهاش — ۳۸.۲. خیلی بد نیست. غذا خورده؟

branches.suggestion: He only had a bit of toast at teatime.
branches.suggestionFa: سر شام فقط یه کم نون تست خورد.

branches.suggestion: Not much. He pushed his dinner away.
branches.suggestionFa: زیاد نه. شامش را پس زد.

cultureNote.en: In the UK, a temperature of 38°C or above counts as a fever.

n4.speaker: weda
n4.text: Little ones often go off their food. Could you fetch the Calpol from the cupboard and a glass of water?

translations.fa: کوچولوها اغلب بی‌اشتها میشن. می‌تونی کالپول را از کابینت بیاری و یه لیوان آب؟

branches.suggestion: Of course — here's the Calpol and some water.
branches.suggestionFa: حتماً — اینم کالپول و یه کم آب.

branches.suggestion: Which cupboard? The one above the kettle?
branches.suggestionFa: کدوم کابینت؟ اونی که بالای کتریه؟

cultureNote.en: Calpol is a common children's paracetamol syrup in the UK. Always check the dose on the box.

n5.speaker: weda
n5.text: That's the one. Five millilitres for his age — check the box, would you?

translations.fa: همونه. برای سنش پنج میلی‌لیتر — جعبه را چک می‌کنی؟

branches.suggestion: It says five ml for ages two to four.
branches.suggestionFa: نوشته پنج میلی برای دو تا چهار سال.

branches.suggestion: Yes, five ml, every four to six hours.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، پنج میلی، هر چهار تا شش ساعت.

n6.speaker: weda
n6.text: Good. Open wide, my darling… there. Brave boy. Now let's get him cool — not cold, mind.

translations.fa: خوبه. دهنت را باز کن عزیزم… بفرما. پسر شجاع. حالا خنکش کنیم — نه سرد، مواظب باش.

branches.suggestion: Shall I open the window a bit?
branches.suggestionFa: پنجره را یه کم باز کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Should I take his jumper off?

n7.speaker: weda
n7.text: Yes, just a vest and a light blanket. In my day, we wrapped them up warm. Doctors say otherwise now.

translations.fa: آره، فقط یه زیرپوش و یه پتوی سبک. زمان ما، گرم می‌پیچیدیمشون. دکترها الان چیز دیگه‌ای می‌گن.

branches.suggestion: My mum wrapped me up warm too!

n8.speaker: weda
n8.text: Mothers everywhere, eh? Look, his eyes are closing. Will you sit with him while I make some tea?

translations.fa: مادرها همه جا، ها؟ ببین، چشماش داره بسته میشه. تا من چای درست می‌کنم پیشش می‌شینی؟

branches.suggestion: Of course. I'll read him a story.
Yes. I'll sing him a Persian lullaby.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. براش یه لالایی فارسی می‌خونم.

n9.speaker: weda
n9.text: Thank you, pet. If he's not better by morning, we'll ring 111. You're a natural with him.

translations.fa: ممنون عزیزم. اگه تا صبح بهتر نشد، به ۱۱۱ زنگ می‌زنیم. تو ذاتاً باهاش خوبی.
